# codegen: Svelte Link emits a11y warning `a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex`

Status: fixed (codegen 2.0)

**Context.** `packages/ui/svelte/ui/link/Link.svelte` (generated by @ui8kit/codegen) renders `<a … tabindex={disabled ? -1 : undefined} {...rest}>`.
Without a static `href`, the Svelte compiler cannot prove the `<a>` is interactive and warns on every SvelteKit build of apps/design.

**Repro.** `cd apps/design && bun run build` → `Link.svelte:43:0 noninteractive element cannot have nonnegative tabIndex value`.

**Impact.** Noise in every build log; easy to miss real a11y warnings.

**Proposed fix.** Destructure `href` explicitly and pass `href={href}` on the anchor, or add `<!-- svelte-ignore a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex -->` in the emitter template.

**Resolution (2026-10-18).** The codegen 2.0 Svelte emitter no longer triggers the warning: `bun run build` in the Svelte design app logs no a11y warnings.
